dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: Got it. I won't let Ajaw scare anyone.

dialogues.speaker: Ajaw
dialogues.text: Scare people? Bwahaha! Know that the Almighty Dragonlord's mere presence is an awe-inspiring thing!

dialogues.speaker: Ajaw
dialogues.text: Ki! Ni! Ch! What did you just say!?

dialogues.speaker: Ajaw
dialogues.text: Oh? Ohohoho, look who crawled out of their hidey-hole. Here to scrape up some work?

dialogues.speaker: Ajaw
dialogues.text: Too bad, too bad! All the lucrative gigs are already under the purview of the Almighty Dragonlord, and we—

dialogues.speaker: Kinich
dialogues.text: #Ignore Ajaw, {NICKNAME}. If you'd like any commissions, I can recommend you some.

response.speaker: Kinich
response.text: Right. And if you need any help, just ask.

response.speaker: Ajaw
response.text: Help? Oh, how noble, how high-minded! How about you—

response.speaker: Kinich
response.text: Save your breath for the monsters we'll be fighting.
